Day Itinerary

Saturday, October 24, 2026 · All times local CDT. These are planning targets and typical traffic estimates, not guaranteed arrivals. Recheck traffic, venue hours and parking before leaving.

6:20 AM target
Leave home · Austin & Rin
Typical drive to Jett's: 10 minutes / 5.4 miles, plus about 10 minutes of cushion for the 6:40 meetup. Use your private saved home route; no home address is published here.
About 6:10 AM target
Leave Ethel · Nana
Google Maps' Ethel town-point estimate is typically 14–18 minutes / 12.1 miles to Jett's. Your actual driveway may add time; allow a cushion and adjust privately.
6:40 AM meetup
MayMay · meet at Jett's
Choose your home departure privately to arrive by 6:40 AM; no origin or drive time has been assumed.
6:40–7:00 AM · 20-minute stop
1. Jett's #3 · fuel and meetup
9645 Main St, Zachary. Fuel, restroom and quick breakfast/coffee as available. Be ready to leave at 7:00 AM; keep the total stop to 20 minutes.
7:00 AM departure · about 9:15 AM parking target
2. Drive to Canal Place parking
Garage address: 333 Canal St, New Orleans; entrance on Badine St E. Allow generous time for traffic, finding a space, unloading and walking. Fees and space availability apply; no free parking is promised.
9:45 AM entrance target · 10:00 AM regular opening
3. Audubon Aquarium & Insectarium
Head toward the attraction entrance after parking and take breaks as needed. Regular hours are daily 10 AM–5 PM; no October 24 exception has been verified. This plan aims to be ready for regular opening, not early admission. Use actual valid tickets.
10:00 AM onward · flexible pace
4. Aquarium, Insectarium and butterflies
Explore at the family's pace with rest breaks. Keep the visit flexible around lunch rather than rushing to a fixed finish time.
Around noon–1:30 PM, or later if preferred
5. Flexible lunch and rest
Café Aqua on the Aquarium's second floor offers sandwiches, salads and kids' meals with indoor seating. Its service hours are unverified; check on arrival. Alternatively choose a nearby lunch spot. Aquarium same-day re-entry requires proof of purchase; keep it handy and confirm arrangements with staff before leaving.
2:45–3:00 PM · flexible daylight-departure target
6. Nana's departure after lunch/rest
Adjust for comfort, traffic and daylight. Confirm the return route privately; no traffic-free route or home-arrival time is guaranteed. Your guide ends here; enjoy the rest of your day.Say goodbye to Nana before any optional shopping.
After lunch and Nana's sendoff · time permitting
7. Optional Quarter gem shops
Earth Odyssey, 306 Chartres St, then French Quarter Gem & Lapidary, 527 St Philip St. Check opening hours locally and allow walking/rest time. Skip or shorten shopping if needed for the parade.
Remaining afternoon · before parade setup
8. Optional Jackson Square & Café du Monde
Beignets and a relaxed look around only if time and energy allow. Leave enough time to reach the parade viewing area; this is not a fixed-duration booking.
6:30 PM parade start · finish varies
9. Krewe of BOO!
Keep the parade primary. Traffic, crowd movement and its finish time are uncertain.

Venue references: official hours · Café Aqua · Aquarium FAQs and re-entry. Morning local-drive estimates were checked in Google Maps for October 24, arriving at Jett's by 6:40 AM.

Two optional detours

Saturday, October 24, 2026 · All hours are local CDT (UTC−5). These are optional visits, not reservations or admission tickets.

Witch Depot · Kenner

2327 Veterans Blvd, Suite L, Kenner — behind Boost Mobile. A metaphysical shop with crystals, candles, books and jewelry.

Regular Saturday hours: 11 a.m.–5 p.m. An October 24 exception has not been confirmed. No admission fee is advertised; purchases are optional. Accessibility is unverified.

A separate driving stop, only if time permits as a separate optional detour. The 11 a.m. opening does not fit the existing 10 a.m. aquarium plan without a separate decision; no arrival time is booked.

Source: Witch Depot official store.

Ghost Manor · Magazine & Second

2502 Magazine Street, New Orleans. An all-ages Halloween display with free public sidewalk viewing.

October 24 show: 7–10 p.m. CDT. It overlaps the Krewe of BOO! parade, which starts at 6:30 p.m. Keep the parade primary; consider Ghost Manor afterward only if parade duration and traffic allow arrival before 10 p.m. No travel or finish time is guaranteed.

Nana's early departure stays unchanged; this night stop is not required. Seating, restrooms, accessibility and the show-loop duration are unconfirmed.
